invariants.rationale: Method expects non-null input records to process; null input may result in NPE.
The HoodieTable instance is required for all subsequent operations, so it should not be null.
HoodieWriteConfig contains configuration for the bulk insert and must be provided.
BulkInsertPartitioner is used to repartition records, must be non-null.
Parallelism should be a positive integer for shuffle and write operations.
